title: Kernel-Smith: a unified recipe for evolutionary kernel optimization
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Fudan University, MetaX
gist: An evolutionary agent keeps a population of runnable kernel candidates with compile, correctness and speed feedback, and recycles its search trajectories into training data for a specialised model. Targets NVIDIA and a Chinese GPU vendor.
changes: Its kernels were merged into production engines, and its own numbers show the dilution: a kernel 4.78x faster alone was worth about 1% end to end.
caveats: The merged pull requests have not been checked. Evaluated on the benchmark protocol later shown to be inflated. Data on request only.

bears_on.note: The authors' own end-to-end numbers are two orders smaller than their kernel numbers.
Search trajectories become training data for the next model.
The code landed in real engines. The effect was about one percent.
